violations.text: The door to the outside, located at the entrance, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 11/16/2026

The dishwasher at the bar is lacking an air gap. A direct connection must not exist between the sewage system and a drain originating from equipment in which food is placed. New Violation. Correct By: 11/16/2026

The walls in the mop sink area are not smooth, durable, easily cleanable, and non-absorbent. Materials for wall surfaces shall be smooth, durable, easily cleanable, and non-absorbent for areas subject to moisture such as food preparation areas, walk-in refrigerators, ware-washing and mop sink areas, and toilet rooms. Walls must be finished using proper materials. The floor in a section of the bar is unsealed cement and wood. This is not smooth, durable, easily cleanable, and non-absorbent. Floor is to be finished using proper materials. New Violation. Correct By: 12/07/2026

Ambient temperature of the prep unit was observed held at 63 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Service to install new thermostat is scheduled for today. New Violation. Correct By: 11/10/2026
Spray bottle used for storing chemicals taken from bulk supplies was not marked with the common name of the chemical. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/09/2026

The door to the outside, located at the entrance, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 11/16/2026

The dishwasher at the bar is lacking an air gap. A direct connection must not exist between the sewage system and a drain originating from equipment in which food is placed. Proper air gap must be installed. New Violation. Correct By: 11/16/2026
The receptacle in the women's toilet room is lacking a cover. A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. New Violation. Correct By: 11/10/2026
The door to the woman's restroom is not self-closing. New Violation. Correct By: 11/16/2026

The walls in the mop sink area are not smooth, durable, easily cleanable, and non-absorbent. Materials for wall surfaces shall be smooth, durable, easily cleanable, and non-absorbent for areas subject to moisture such as food preparation areas, walk-in refrigerators, ware-washing and mop sink areas, and toilet rooms. Walls must be finished using proper materials. The ceiling in the kitchen has a couple of pieces of wood attached. Wood is not smooth, durable, and easily cleanable. Wood is to be removed and replaced using proper materials. The floor in a section of the bar is unsealed cement and wood. This is not smooth, durable, easily cleanable, and non-absorbent. Floor is to be finished using proper materials. New Violation. Correct By: 12/07/2026
